serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Procore for Government is a purpose-built platform for managing construction. It supports public sector entities, program managers, and their contractors to coordinate more effectively, control costs, and manage risk across every phase of a capital asset’s lifecycle. Designed for construction and capital programs, Procore connects internal teams, contractors, and stakeholders through real-time data in one secure, easy-to-use system. The platform provides configurable workflows and secure document management to support core construction functions, including bidding, project management, quality and safety, and cost management. Procore for Government is designed to support the operational needs of public infrastructure, government facilities, and capital asset programs while supporting compliance, accountability, and long-term asset performance.

Procore for Government solution areas can include:

Preconstruction

Project Management

Quality & Safety

Financials

Reporting & Analytics
